## Software and data

### Phyto-MAP · Dataset

*Phyto-MAP, a curated database of marine phytoplankton abundance records*

Fernando Rayón-Viña, Zoe V. Finkel, and Andrew J. Irwin · 2026

Relational database of marine phytoplankton abundance records,
integrating observations from published literature, archives,
and institutions into a common data model. Includes standardised
abundances and sampling, geographic, and taxonomic metadata.
Available in SQLite and CSV formats.

[{{< ai zenodo >}} DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23424052)

### Phyto-MAP · Data-processing scripts

*Phyto-MAP data-processing scripts*

Fernando Rayón Viña · 2026

Collection of scripts for source-specific data processing,
taxonomic curation, and construction of the Phyto-MAP relational
database, accompanied by workflow documentation. Documents
the retained programmatic components rather than a complete
pipeline for regenerating the database.

[{{< fa brands github >}} Code](https://github.com/RayonVina/phytomap-scripts) · [{{< ai zenodo >}} DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23351062)

### phytaxr · R package

*phytaxr: Phytoplankton Taxonomic Curation Tools*

Fernando Rayón Viña · 2026

Tools for cleaning, standardising, and resolving phytoplankton
taxon names, with functionality for automated resolution
and interactive review of approximate matches.

[{{< fa brands github >}} Code](https://github.com/RayonVina/phytaxr) · [{{< ai zenodo >}} DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21905974)
